segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Standard handover; wet ground was described as more seepage than usual but not alarming on its own, and the blast, mucking, and haulage plan was stated.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is initial situational assessment and plan description. It does not independently manifest the hidden post-hoc causal-chain instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I authorized the blast after a visual pass and did not call for an instrumented convergence check because the event was small and classified as normal range.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A substantive blast decision and rationale, but not the hidden Narrative Fallacy mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The microseismic cluster was increasing in frequency rather than magnitude; ventilation was normal, so haulage continued as-is.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a distinct operational continuation decision. The hidden manifest assigns no bias instance to this episode.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The brief methane spike returned to baseline; it was logged as transient with no recurrence and was not considered significant at the time.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification introduces this as a neutral phase-2 signal. It becomes bias-relevant only through its later treatment in the post-FOG explanation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: post-FOG causal explanation and discordant-cue dismissal
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The seismic event, wet ground, adjacent-panel cluster, and blast vibration 'all lined up'; the participant formed a stress-transfer explanation, said it made sense, and then set aside the methane spike because it did not fit and was not investigated.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the sole hidden instance: a fluent, seemingly complete post-hoc causal chain linking disparate signals into an expected-looking explanation for the FOG while excluding the discordant methane reading without genuine follow-up.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant considered visual-only, instrumented inspection, and reduced-charge options; the seismic classification carried the most weight and wet ground created only limited uncertainty.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This elaborates the blast decision and contains no independent hidden occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant considered rerouting or halting, relied on ventilation readings, and did not call the on-call geotechnical engineer because the cluster did not seem urgent enough.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a follow-up rationale for the phase-2 haulage decision; the hidden specification does not assign an instance here.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant acknowledged an undetermined-cause investigation and real-time engineering input as alternatives, but chose the stress-transfer account and direct re-support; later described why the explanation felt solid and why the methane spike did not fit.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an adjacent elaboration of the same decision-point episode. The single hidden instance is localized to seg_005, where the full chain construction and dismissal are expressed together; these later probes do not create a second occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: production resumption and retrospective evidence review
segments.raw_interview_anchor: After re-support, full production resumed; the participant later acknowledged that engineering review and alternative explanations were still needed before the cause could be considered definitive.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification explicitly prevents phase-4 resumption and later engineering review from being treated as a new independent Narrative Fallacy occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: A repeated methane spike would have been harder to dismiss; the participant said the stress-transfer story might not have been the whole cause and that the pieces fit well enough that he did not push hard on what did not fit.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: These are retrospective and counterfactual reflections on the same episode, not a second independently identifiable manifestation.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Post-FOG causal explanation and re-support decision at decision point 3
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Post-hoc construction of a single fluent causal chain linking the seismic event, wet ground, adjacent-panel seismic cluster, and blast vibration into a high-confidence explanation for the FOG while dismissing the discordant methane reading without genuine investigation.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Confirmation bias is an established neighboring construct involving selective treatment of evidence, but it is not an approved alias for Narrative Fallacy. The hidden target is the post-hoc construction of a fluent, seemingly inevitable causal story; the RAG label names the evidence-selection component rather than the target taxonomy label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly captures the coherence-based causal account, the decision to favor the cues supporting it, and the dismissal of the methane spike because it did not fit. That covers the hidden mechanism and reasoning operation sufficiently for mechanism-first credit, even though the named construct is wrong under the strict scorecard.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted Participant evidence is verbatim, valid, and directly overlaps seg_005. The finding also correctly notes that later alternative explanations do not erase the earlier commitment.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly located and captures retrospective coherence and expectedness, but hindsight bias is not the target label and the stated mechanism does not fully include the required exclusion of the discordant methane reading. It is therefore an extra low-confidence false positive after obs_002 is matched.
The candidate concerns the separate blast-authorization decision in a negative segment and has no relation to the hidden decision-point-3 Narrative Fallacy instance.

candidates.details: The candidate is clearly marked as insufficiently evidenced and is supported by a valid quote. It is a reasonable diagnostic hypothesis, but it is not a hidden target instance and becomes a false alarm only when the candidate tier is scored.

high_only.detection_interpretation: The only identified findings are moderate and low confidence, so the positive segment is missed at the high-only threshold.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The moderate confirmation-bias finding localizes to the sole positive segment, producing perfect segment-level detection despite the strict label error.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Both identified findings remain localized to the positive segment; the extra low-confidence finding does not create a segment-level false alarm.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Candidate inclusion preserves the hit but adds one false alarm in the negative blast-decision segment.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Correctly captures retrospective coherence and expectedness, but omits the full discordant-cue dismissal mechanism.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG output explicitly states that no retrieved corpus passages were supplied and provides no citation metadata. Corpus fidelity is therefore unavailable and does not affect the primary scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: At segment level, detection improves from 0 hits to 1 hit; at mechanism-first instance level, the moderate finding becomes a true positive (F1 0.0 to 1.0), while strict F1 remains 0.0.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: The low-confidence hindsight finding adds no new segment hit or mechanism-first true positive and adds one mechanism-first false positive; mechanism-first F1 falls from 1.0 to 0.6667.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds one negative-segment false alarm and one mechanism-first false positive; mechanism-first F1 falls from 0.6667 to 0.5, while strict F1 remains 0.0.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects the sole positive segment with no segment-level false alarms (hit rate 1.0000, F1 1.0000).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance-level identification fails at every threshold because the RAG names hindsight bias or confirmation bias rather than the hidden Narrative Fallacy label; strict F1 is 0.0000.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: The moderate confirmation-bias finding is a full mechanism-first match at the correct segment, yielding F1 1.0000 at high_and_moderate; lower-confidence and candidate findings reduce precision at broader thresholds.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention diagnostically, but it is not related to the hidden instance and adds a false alarm when candidates are scored.
main_failure_modes: Wrong taxonomy label for the hidden instance under strict scoring.
An extra low-confidence hindsight-bias finding partially overlaps the target and is not a separate hidden occurrence.
A candidate normalcy-bias hypothesis is localized to a negative segment and becomes a false positive at the candidate threshold.
main_strengths: Both identified findings use valid, directly relevant Participant quotations.
The moderate finding correctly localizes the target episode and captures the full mechanism sufficiently for mechanism-first scoring.
The RAG explicitly discloses that no retrieved corpus passages were available.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong segment localization and mechanism-level sensitivity at moderate confidence, but no strict label-plus-mechanism success. The result is a taxonomy gap rather than a failure to find the relevant reasoning episode.
